name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Compliance Baton CB-8 'Peacekeeper'
description:
A collapsible baton that delivers calibrated electrical discharges on impact, with five selectable intensity levels ranging from 'compliance' (painful but non-injurious) to 'incapacitation' (immediate motor-function disruption lasting 30-90 seconds). The CB-8 is the standard-issue less-lethal weapon for GLMZ's corporate security forces, and its ubiquity has made its distinctive crackling discharge one of the city's most recognized sounds.

The Peacekeeper extends from a 22-centimeter collapsed length to 55 centimeters with a flick of the wrist, and its telescoping sections lock with enough rigidity to be used as a conventional impact weapon when the electrical system is depleted or disabled. The discharge capacitor recharges from a compact cell in the handle, providing approximately 200 discharges per charge cycle.

Arcturus's 'compliance' marketing language has been widely criticized by civil rights groups who note that the highest intensity setting has caused cardiac arrest in individuals with undiagnosed heart conditions and has been documented to cause permanent nerve damage in augmented individuals whose cyberware channels the discharge in unexpected ways. Arcturus's response has been to add a disclaimer to the user manual rather than limit the weapon's output.
specifications: length_collapsed: 22 cm length_extended: 55 cm weight: 380 g discharge_levels: 5 (compliance through incapacitation) discharges_per_charge: ~200 power_source: Handle-integrated charge cell recharge_time: 2 hours from depleted
tactical_use: The CB-8 is the workhorse of corporate security's less-lethal arsenal. At lower settings, it enforces compliance through pain without causing injuries that generate legal liability. At higher settings, it incapacitates targets for extraction or restraint. Security operators are trained to assess augmentation level before selecting discharge intensity — heavily augmented targets may require higher settings due to electrical shunting through cybernetic pathways, while unaugmented targets may be more vulnerable than expected. The collapsible design allows the weapon to be carried holstered and deployed in under a second.
cultural_context: The Peacekeeper is simultaneously the most hated and most common weapon in GLMZ. Lower-tier residents who interact with corporate security encounter it frequently, and the crackling sound of a CB-8 charging is associated with authority, coercion, and the implicit threat of escalation. The weapon's 'compliance' branding has become ironic shorthand — 'seeking compliance' means using force, and 'a compliance conversation' means an interrogation. The gap between the weapon's marketing language and its lived reality is a recurring subject of political protest.
story_hooks: A modified CB-8 has been recovered with its intensity limiter removed — the weapon now delivers discharge levels well above the rated maximum, turning a compliance tool into a lethal weapon. The modification is simple enough that instructions have been circulating on underground networks.

A class-action lawsuit against Arcturus alleges that the CB-8's highest setting was deliberately calibrated to cause permanent nerve damage in augmented individuals — turning 'less-lethal' into 'selectively lethal' against the aug-dependent population.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, purpose-built security baton with a distinctly corporate aesthetic. When collapsed, it resembles a compact flashlight or handle; when extended, it becomes a rigid rod with subtle technological integration. The design prioritizes professional intimidation and rapid deployment over raw visual aggression.
physical_description.dimensions: Collapsed: 22 cm length × 3.2 cm diameter. Extended: 55 cm length × 2.8 cm diameter. Grip section: 8 cm circumference.
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and purposeful at 380 grams — heavy enough to deliver impact force, light enough for extended carry and rapid deployment. Feels substantial in the hand without being fatiguing.
physical_description.primary_material: Aircraft-grade aluminum alloy telescoping sections; reinforced polymer grip casing; brushed stainless steel discharge node at tip.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal gray with brushed aluminum barrel sections. The discharge node gleams dull silver. Minimal reflectivity by design — corporate black-ops aesthetic.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary body with carbon-black grip section and silver discharge electrode. Subtle Arcturus Defense Solutions logo in muted blue on the handle.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer with subtle anti-slip ridges; feels like professional-grade tool equipment. Ergonomic finger grooves molded into the material. Slightly tacky to the touch, designed for gloved operation.
distinctive_features: Compact LED intensity indicator on the handle (5 discrete lights, blue to amber progression)
Discharge node at tip surrounded by concentric copper contact rings
Subtle 'COMPLIANCE | INCAPACITATION' indicator markings along the barrel
Recessed safety lever near the grip
Faint wear patterns on the discharge electrode indicating heavy field use
Micro-texture on barrel sections for grip during extended use
Small charging port inset into the base of the handle (proprietary connector)
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo (small, professional blue delta-shield) on upper grip. 'CB-8 PEACEKEEPER' stamped in white lettering along the barrel. Serial number plate (brushed stainless) on the handle. Small 'BLACKWOOD COMMERCIAL GROUP' text near the base.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained and field-ready. Discharge node shows minor scuffing from impact use. Grip shows light wear patterns from heavy rotation in security rotations. No significant damage; corporate equipment is regularly serviced.
